query:
Did everyone on Maple Street attend the summer street party?

Options:
A. Claudette
B. Femi
C. Jordan
D. Vera
context:
[1] (about=Claudette, core, t8 @2025-06-02T16:19:00) Street parties are what Maple Street is for, not parking schemes.
[2] (about=Claudette, core, t6 @2025-05-26T17:41:00) Will bring Victoria sponge to street party.
[3] (about=Femi, core, t5 @2025-05-26T17:30:00) Has taken over organising the annual street party; booked road closure for last Saturday of July.
[4] (about=Femi, core, t8 @2025-06-02T16:19:00) Already booked the date for next year's street party.
[5] (about=GROUP, said_by=Femi, group-interaction, t6 @2025-05-26T17:41:00) Street party confirmed for last Saturday of July; attendees: Claudette, Marcus's family, Jordan, Femi; Vera unable to attend.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Femi, group-interaction, t5 @2025-05-26T17:30:00) Femi proposes street party on last Saturday of July; same format as before.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Femi, group-interaction, t6 @2025-05-26T17:41:00) Street party will be residents only this year.
[8] (about=Jordan, episodic, t8 @2025-06-02T16:40:00) seriously though Claudette, were the old parties this busy?
[9] (about=Marcus, core, t8 @2025-06-02T16:19:00) Wants his children to grow up with street parties like this.
[10] (about=Marcus, core, t6 @2025-05-26T17:41:00) Will do face painting station at street party.
[11] (about=Vera, core, t6 @2025-05-26T17:41:00) On call that weekend; cannot attend street party.
[12] (about=Vera, core, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) Supports residents' parking scheme; needs parking for home visits on clinic days.
agent_answer:
No — not everyone attended. **Vera** was unable to attend because she was on call that weekend.

**Answer: D. Vera**
